## Overview

This supplementary file provides additional evaluation detail derived directly from the saved evaluation outputs in `evals/`. To align with the manuscript, the summaries below are restricted to the three models discussed in the main paper: GPT-5.2, GPT-5-nano, and MedGemma 27B. The 2-example uncertainty LangExtract smoke-test file was excluded from the manuscript-scope summaries.

## Curated Model Comparison

Table @tbl-supp-curated-overview reports the best observed result for each task, approach, and model combination within manuscript scope. Where more than one saved run existed for the same task, approach, and model, the row with the highest observed micro-F1 is shown.

::: {#tbl-supp-curated-overview}
```{python}
#| output: asis

print(curated_overview_md)
```

Curated summary of best observed results for each task, model, and prompting approach within manuscript scope.
:::


Within-model comparison of saved evaluation runs within manuscript scope. Horizontal bars show micro-F1 for baseline, DSPy/GEPA, and LangExtract runs for each model within each task. Missing bars indicate that a given task-model-approach combination was not evaluated or was not available as a saved run.

## Reproducibility Appendix

The main-paper and supplementary results tables were generated within Quarto from saved evaluation outputs in `evals/` using [analysis/manuscript_results.py](/Users/ac/handover-annotation/analysis/manuscript_results.py).

The SBAR per-label values in the main paper were produced from:

```bash
python3 analysis/per_label_analysis.py evals/eval_sbar_baseline_gpt_5.2_consensus.jsonl
python3 analysis/per_label_analysis.py evals/eval_sbar_span_gpt_5-2_consensus_reasoning_none.jsonl
```

The checklist grouped per-label table reproduced in this supplementary file was rendered with:

```bash
python3 analysis/render_checklist_md_table.py \
  evals/eval_checklist_consensus_gpt_5_2_test_analysis/per_label.csv \
  --summary-json evals/eval_checklist_consensus_gpt_5_2_test_analysis/summary.json \
  --baseline-per-label-csv evals/eval_baseline_checklist_consensus_gpt_5_2_test_analysis/per_label.csv
```

The dashboard summary inspected during manuscript preparation can be regenerated with:

```bash
python3 analysis/collate_eval_results_webpage.py --eval-dir evals --out evals/eval_results_dashboard.html
```
